messages.content: Recheck the Oregon coast hotels before we commit. I want to make sure the dates still run north to south and that all eight nights are covered.

The sequence still works: Cannon Beach from July 12 to July 15 for three nights, Yachats from July 15 to July 19 for four nights, then the Portland airport hotel from July 19 to July 20. That covers eight consecutive nights with no gaps.
Good. Reprice the exact room arrangements for the three of us, not substitute room types.

All three are still available for two adults and one 12-year-old. Cannon Beach has the two-queen room at $1,538 total, including $191 in taxes and property fees. Yachats has the king room with a sofa bed confirmed for the third guest at $1,876 total, including $228 in taxes and fees. The airport two-queen room is $275 total, including $39 in taxes and fees. Combined lodging is $3,689.
How much did Yachats move, and is changing the week cheaper overall?

Yachats increased by $128. The other two totals are unchanged. Moving everything to the adjacent week would add about $310 across the three properties, so keeping these dates remains less expensive by roughly $182.
What are the balcony situations on those exact rooms?

The Cannon Beach room has a private balcony. The Yachats king is on the first floor with direct lawn access but no balcony. A balcony room there is no longer available with both a king and a confirmed sofa bed. The airport room has neither a balcony nor exterior access.

Keep the Yachats room. For family coastal stays, prioritize a balcony when one is available, but a first-floor room is a separate case and can be fine without one. I don't want an otherwise good hotel ruled out over that.
Understood. I’ll keep the first-floor Yachats room because the sleeping arrangement and route still fit, while retaining the balcony room at Cannon Beach.
Before booking, give me cancellation, parking, and check-in for each.

Cannon Beach: free cancellation until 6:00 p.m. local time on July 5, free self-parking, check-in from 4:00 p.m. Yachats: free cancellation until 4:00 p.m. on July 8, free self-parking, check-in from 4:00 p.m. Portland airport: free cancellation until 11:59 p.m. on July 18, parking is $15 for the night, and check-in begins at 3:00 p.m. The quoted airport total already includes that parking charge.
And the sofa bed is explicitly guaranteed for our son, not just requested?

Yes. The Yachats inventory record lists one king plus one double sofa bed, with occupancy accepted for two adults and one child. It is part of the reserved room type, not a special request. The other reservations each list two queen beds and occupancy for three.
Book all three at those cancellable rates using the traveler details and card already on file.

All eight nights are reserved. Cannon Beach, July 12-15: two queens with private balcony, three guests, $1,538 total, confirmation CB7K42; cancel by 6:00 p.m. July 5, free parking, 4:00 p.m. check-in. Yachats, July 15-19: first-floor king with confirmed double sofa bed, three guests, $1,876 total, confirmation YA4M81; cancel by 4:00 p.m. July 8, free parking, 4:00 p.m. check-in. Portland airport, July 19-20: two queens, three guests, $275 total including one night of $15 parking, confirmation PDX9R6; cancel by 11:59 p.m. July 18, 3:00 p.m. check-in. The north-to-south sequence is complete, and the combined total is $3,689.
